English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #false Did Prof. Meththika Vithanage declare her support to Sajith? False A social media post claiming that Professor Meththika Vithanage, a Senior Lecturer at the Faculty of Applied Sciences, Sri Jayewardenepura University, is supporting SJB’s presidential candidate Sajith Premadasa caught the attention of FactSeeker. by Anonymous | September 5, 2024 The post in question states, “Professor Meththika Vithanage from the Faculty of Applied Sciences at Sri Jayewardenepura University has decided to support the presidential candidate of the Samagi Jana Balawegaya.” To verify the authenticity of this claim, FactSeeker contacted Professor Meththika Vithanage who stated that she had never met Sajith Premadasa in-person. She confirmed that the photograph included in the post is fabricated. Additionally, she provided the original photograph used to alter the image, which was taken at an Annual Research Review of the National Institute of Fundamental Studies (NIFS) on March 28. The image was also posted on NIFS’s official Facebook page. In response to our inquiry, SJB’s media unit also confirmed that that the image was altered. Accordingly, FactSeeker confirms that the post claiming Professor Meththika Vithanage’s alleged support for Sajith Premadasa in this presidential election is false. We are an independent fact-checking team affiliated with the Sri Lanka Press Institute(SLPI). The objective and long-term goal of the FactSeeker is to provide the public with reliable and verified content in the attempt of debunking mis/disinformation. The unit, with the SLPI, is committed to contributing to improved media literacy in Sri Lanka.
